description:
Utilizes established relationships with Wellmark leaders and acts as a consultant on platform capabilities, engineering delivery challenges, process improvements, and technology enhancements. Provides technical leadership and contributes to the direction and evolution of the internal developer platform initiatives, including software catalogs, platform integrations, self-service experiences, and continuous improvement of developer workflows.

 Preferred: 
 Experience working within Agile product delivery or software engineering environments.
 Experience building or supporting internal developer platforms, developer portals, and self-service engineering capabilities.
 Experience developing internal developer platform integrations, automation, and self-service capabilities using AWS services, APIs, SDKs, and infrastructure as code
 Experience integrating internal developer platforms with source control, cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, security tooling, documentation, observability solutions, service management systems, and enterprise data sources.
 Experience designing software catalogs, scorecards, health checks, or similar platform capabilities.
 Experience developing self-service workflows, templates, automation, documentation, and onboarding capabilities that improve developer productivity and platform adoption.
 Experience identifying developer friction and driving measurable improvements across developer journeys, tools, processes, platforms, and teams.
 Experience using platform health, adoption, usage, reliability, or developer productivity measures to identify opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
 Experience operating and continuously improving an internal engineering platform, including monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and service ownership.
 Experience applying product management principles to internal engineering platforms, including gathering developer feedback, prioritizing capabilities, and measuring platform adoption, effectiveness, and alignment with engineering standards.
 Required:  
 Bachelor's Degree or direct and applicable work experience 
 Minimum 7 years of experience including development experience, innovative solutions, infrastructure, architecture design and operations 
 Minimum 4 years of experience in IT infrastructure, architecture design, operations 
 Informal leadership, coaching, mentoring, architecture design, stakeholder consulting, problem solving and strong communication skills. 
 
 a. Lead the technical designs for highly integrated complex application platforms to optimize security, information leverage and reuse, integration, performance, and availability and ensure solutions developed adhere and align to the architecture standards. 
 b. Consult with Solution Architects and project teams in the creation and documentation of design deliverables for application platforms and collaborate on effective technology solutions. 
 c. May oversee and lead planning, developing and estimating of technical solutions and collaborate with other technical teams. 
 d. Collaborate with Lead Architect, business systems analyst and stakeholders regarding process improvements. 
 e. Consult with business stakeholders regarding technical planning to ensure architectures align with business expectations. 
 f. Oversee, review and provide technical guidance on supported solutions, including vendor evaluations and integrations. 
 g. Support architecture governance standards and provide guidance regarding IT policies, security and infrastructure. 
 h. Provide training and mentorship regarding technical design and solution implementation. 
 i. Build strong business relationships to ensure technical designs align with business needs. 
 j. Develop and apply industry best practices and recommend emerging technologies. 
 k. Other duties as assigned. 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
 An Equal Opportunity Employer 
 The policy of Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield is to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 
 Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact us at careers@wellmark.com 

 Please inform us if you meet the definition of a " Covered DoD official ". 

 At this time, Wellmark is not considering applicants for this position that require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For additional information around work authorization needs please refer to the following resources: Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants
